decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is core to the firm's accessible, low-profile direction, and the renovation demand during 2020-2021 likely kept results at or above aspiration, so no problemistic search is triggered.
As the flagship designer line it carries the firm's design-quality identity, and without clear evidence of a shortfall management would keep it rather than abandon its focal product.
The backflow-protected basement drain meets a clear and growing safety need from heavy-rain events, so its performance likely meets aspirations and justifies keeping it.
The air-admittance valve is peripheral to the design focus, but it is a cheap complementary line that rounds out the drainage range, and slack lets the firm carry it absent a clear shortfall.
